Maya: random q — if you could pick one weird/quirky superpower (totally useless or oddly specific), what would it be? 🦥
Liam: The power to always get the seat by the window on planes. small, but elite. ✈️
Ava: I want the ability to instantly know which pantry item will go stale first. saves snacks. 🥨
Ravi: Make plants sing to you when they're thirsty. houseplants duet. 🎶🌿
Zoë: To teleport you to the nearest taco truck. priorities. 🌮
Ken: To have a personal 1-second time-skip to avoid stepping on Legos. painful tech. 😅
Priya: The power to change the font on any PDF you open. design hero. 😎
Jules: Summon perfect boiled egg, peeled and halved, on command. breakfast wizard. 🥚
Sam: Ability to remember exactly where you left your keys and why you left them there. 🔑
ops-bot: Reminder: don't forget Friday's coffee trolley in kitchen at 10:30 :coffee:
Maya: These are great. vote emoji for favourite: :taco: for Zoë, :musical_note: for Ravi, :egg: for Jules, :key: for Sam — quick reactions ok :thumbsup:
